Will this kill the dog or be okay?
Can my dog eat 100 organic baby carrots

Your dog should be fine. Toxic foods for dogs are grapes, raisins, onions, garlic, chocolate and MSG. I would say aside from some diarrhea that you might have to deal with, you shouldn't have anything to worry about.

I'm not a veterinarian, but this seems like a bad idea. I can't say for certain if your dog would die... But dogs have been known to "gorge", which is where they eat far more food than they can digest, and it results in them being very sick. I believe it is called Bloat. It can cause serious problems. So, I can't say empirically that doing this would kill your dog, but I would certainly advise against it.
